findings.detail: GAV_BDC02 reported no comparison denominator, but the filing provides a March 31, 2026 total investments fair value denominator of 352,232,987.

rationale: The raw filing is readable and contains the comparison anchor the check says is absent. Table 20 row 5 separately summarizes March 31, 2026 Total Investments at fair value of 352,232,987, matching the schedule total in table 11 row 28; therefore the no_comparison result is a real anchor/extraction defect.
